name: rachdelaguila.github.io (Jekyll / GitHub Pages)
install: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ruby-full build-essential zlib1g-dev git curl ca-certificates && export GEM_HOME="$HOME/.gem" && export PATH="$HOME/.gem/bin:$PATH" && gem install bundler --no-document && bundle install

terminals.name: jekyll-serve
terminals.command: export GEM_HOME="$HOME/.gem" && export PATH="$HOME/.gem/bin:$PATH" && bundle exec jekyll serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4000 --livereload
